projects.name: Long Ridge
projects.location: PJM Interconnection, adjacent to Hannibal operations
projects.quote: The site gives us over 1 GW of total potential capacity and the ability to scale to 600 gross MW of AI and critical IT load over time, supported by a combination of grid expansions and on-site power generation.

projects.name: Long Ridge combined-cycle gas turbine plant
projects.quote: The combined-cycle gas turbine plant has a 505 MW nameplate capacity, with 485 MW currently authorized for sale and an expected increase to the full 505 MW in 2H 2026.

projects.name: Starwood strategic partnership
projects.quote: Our strategic partnership with Starwood to jointly develop, finance, and operate next generation digital infrastructure made meaningful progress during the quarter as we moved from announcement to execution.
